objective: Add a pencil to the cart on Amazon.

steps.title: Search for a pencil
steps.action: Enter 'pencil' in the search bar and submit the search.
steps.expected_result: Search results for pencils are displayed.

steps.title: Select a pencil
steps.action: Click on the first pencil item from the search results.

steps.title: Add pencil to cart
steps.action: Click on the 'Add to Cart' button.
steps.expected_result: Pencil is added to the cart.

steps.title: Verify cart
steps.action: Navigate to the cart to confirm the pencil is added.

success_criteria: Pencil is successfully added to the cart.
Cart displays the correct pencil item.
